raw:
@q query
  mode every
  where match
    relation "receive a pension"
    role subject ?p
    role object ?amount
    role location "our village"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?amount below 1500

@q2 query
  mode every
  where match
    relation "receive a pension"
    role subject ?p
    role object ?amount
    role location "our village"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?amount at_least 1500
